The Roubic Auburn Township Story

Home Base Since 1982

Auburn Township isn't just a service area — it's where Roubic Tree & Landscape started and where it still operates today. The Taylor May Rd yard has been our physical headquarters for 44 continuous years, which means Auburn homeowners get zero mobilization travel, the shortest debris-haul distance in the region, and the fastest emergency response of any city we serve.

This is a rural-suburban Geauga County township of rolling wooded terrain and large lots — 1 to 10-plus acres are common, most of them carrying mature hardwood stands of oak, maple, beech, and ash. That heritage canopy, plus ongoing EAB pressure on ash, keeps removal, pruning, stump grinding, and land clearing in steady demand right in our own backyard.

Auburn is where we started and where we still park the trucks every night. When a neighbor calls, we're not driving in from somewhere else — we're already here. {{global.owner_name}} · Owner

Permits handled when required. Auburn Township follows Geauga County standards — no routine permit for private-property removals — but large-scale clearing can trigger zoning review, and 811 utility mark-out is arranged before any grinding or excavation. Roubic coordinates all of it as part of the estimate.

Common Auburn Township Questions

Auburn Township Tree Service FAQ

Six things Auburn Township homeowners want to know before booking.

Do you serve Auburn Township?
Auburn Township is Roubic's home market — our Taylor May Rd headquarters and yard sit right in the township. It's a Tier 1 flagship service area, and we've operated here continuously since 1982. Call {{global.phone}} for a free estimate.
How fast can Roubic respond in Auburn Township?
Faster than anywhere else we serve, because crews dispatch from the Auburn yard itself. Estimates are scheduled on a priority basis, and for 24/7 storm emergencies we target on-site arrival within 2–4 hours inside the primary service area.
Do I need a permit to remove a tree in Auburn Township?
Generally no — Auburn Township follows Geauga County standards, and routine removals on private residential property don't require a permit. Large-scale land clearing may trigger a zoning review, and 811 utility mark-out is arranged before grinding or excavation. Roubic confirms and coordinates all of it as part of the estimate.
How much does tree removal cost in Auburn Township?
Auburn Township removals typically run $200–$10,000+ depending on size, species, access, and any permit fees. Small trees under 20 ft start around $200–$500; mature 50–80 ft trees run $1,500–$3,500; very large heritage estate trees needing crane assistance can exceed $10,000. Every estimate is free and confirmed on-site before you book.
What tree services are available in Auburn Township?
All six of Roubic's service lines run here: Tree Removal, Tree Trimming & Pruning, Stump Grinding, Land Clearing, Storm Damage & Emergency Tree Care, and Firewood Delivery. Click any service card above for full pricing, process, and details.
Do you deliver firewood in Auburn Township?
Yes — the Auburn Township yard is Roubic's primary firewood source. We deliver locally sourced seasoned hardwood by the face cord, half cord, or full cord, seasoned 6–12 months on the yard and EAB-quarantine compliant.
